title: 有馬記念の後に・本当の祭り

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black dashes through the Arima Kinen. A post-race concert stirs fans into a greater frenzy, setting the perfect mood for a festival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That night, Kitasan Black and Satono Diamond renew their promise, this time to run together in next year's Arima Kinen.
